instruction: Gather all text elements from the presentation slides and assemble them into a Word file named "notes.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting all text from PowerPoint to Word document. Evaluator verifies word count is in range 180-200 (tightened from 160-220) AND verifies content similarity with source PPTX using text matching. Ground truth document: 190 words. Content similarity threshold: 0.75 (combined sequence and Jaccard similarity).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly implements dual-verification: word count range (180-200) AND content similarity with source PPTX
Getter extracts both word count and full text content from DOCX (including paragraphs and tables)
Metric extracts source text from PPTX and calculates two similarity metrics: SequenceMatcher (0.6 weight) for order preservation and Jaccard (0.4 weight) for content coverage
Content similarity threshold of 0.75 ensures text actually originated from the presentation, preventing false positives from random text
Word count range tightened to 180-200 (190±5.3%), significantly reducing false positives compared to previous 160-220 range
Parameter handling is correct: expected receives rules dict directly, uses expected.get('min_words'), expected.get('max_words'), expected.get('source_pptx_path')
Postconfig properly saves file (Ctrl+S) and activates window, ensuring getter can read the DOCX
Robust error handling: returns 0.0 for empty text, missing files, or failed PPTX extraction
Logic flow is semantically correct: checks word count first, then verifies content origin, returns 1.0 only if both pass
All instruction requirements verified: text extraction from slides AND assembly into Word document
